summary: Build a USB-powered four-wire PT100 measurement board for 0–100 degC. Use a 100 uA excitation current and independent sense leads so lead resistance is not substituted for sensor resistance. Report temperature over a 3.3 V UART at at least 10 readings per second, with an absolute error budget of 0.5 degC over the stated range. Do not substitute a thermistor, thermocouple, two-wire measurement or a generic voltage ADC without the required excitation and conversion function.
